title: Debt securities schedule review — Orbis Co.
instructions: Review Orbis Co.'s year-end schedule of debt securities. Flag each amount in error and enter the correct amount. Round to the nearest dollar.

|---|---|---|---|

exhibits.content: Bought January 1 for **$146,830** (face $150,000; 5% annual coupon paid December 31; effective yield **6%**). Orbis uses the effective interest method.
